managePayments.heading: Payments

not_connected.title: Not set up
not_connected.body: Takes about 10 minutes. You’ll need your bank details and ID.

requirements.title: Stripe needs your details
requirements.body: Card payments won’t work until Stripe has your business and bank details.

pending.title: Connected — Stripe is checking your details
pending.body: Nothing for you to do. Stripe is reviewing what you sent, and this page updates when they’re done.

ready.title: Connected
ready.body: Your Stripe account is connected and able to take payments.

restricted.title: Card payments paused
restricted.body: Stripe has paused card payments on your account until something is resolved.

unsupported.title: Card payments aren’t available on this account
unsupported.body: Stripe cannot enable card payments here. Get in touch and we will sort it out with you.

keyMismatch.title: Stripe keys do not match
keyMismatch.body: This site’s server is using its {server, select, live {live} other {test}} Stripe key while the browser was built with the {browser, select, live {live} other {test}} one. Card payments would fail at the moment a customer tries to pay, so setting up Stripe is blocked until they agree.
keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set for the same environment, and the site rebuilt afterwards — the publishable key is baked in at build time, the secret key is read on every request.

permission.title: Only the truck’s owner can set up payments
permission.body: Stripe is connected by the person whose bank account receives the money, so it has to be set up from their own signed-in account. Nothing is wrong with this truck or with HatchGrab.

online.heading: Online payments
online.body: Customers pay by card when they order. Money goes straight to your own Stripe account — we never hold it.
online.feeLine: Stripe charges {fee} per payment on standard {region}. Other cards may cost more. HatchGrab’s own fee on online orders depends on your plan — see Billing.
online.testMode: Test mode. No real payments can be taken yet.

managePayments.trialNote: Setting this up doesn’t start your subscription or charge you anything today. It’s how your customers pay you — your plan is separate.

blocked.body: WhatsApp is refusing to send your automatic replies because of a billing problem on your WhatsApp Business account. Customers can still message you and you will still see everything they send — but they are not getting a reply.
blocked.fix: You pay WhatsApp directly for these messages, so this is fixed in WhatsApp Manager. <link>Check your payment method</link>

limit.heading: Auto-replies

limit.emailAt: Replies pause at your limit. We’ll email you at 80% and 100%.

billing.heading: Billing
billing.summary: Meta, not HatchGrab, bills your WhatsApp account for replies. From {from} the first {free, number} a month are free. Correct at {checked}; check <link>Meta’s pricing</link> for changes.
billing.chargesTitle: Meta charges for WhatsApp replies, not HatchGrab.
billing.chargesBody: Each reply HatchGrab sends for you is billed by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account. From {from}, Meta includes {free, number} free replies a month per number; after that, each reply is charged at Meta’s rate. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app aren’t charged. Meta sets these prices and may change them. <link>See Meta’s pricing</link>
billing.addPaymentInManager: Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
billing.aboveMissing: Your limit is above Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Without a payment method, Meta will stop all replies once those are used.
billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is above Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Replies beyond that need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one, Meta stops all replies once the free ones are used.

disconnect.title: Disconnect WhatsApp?
disconnect.body: Auto-replies stop straight away and HatchGrab loses access to your WhatsApp account. Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab completely, also open WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.

signup.partial: We linked your WhatsApp Business account but could not complete the connection. Nothing is wrong on your side — please contact us and we will finish it.
signup.noNumber: Your WhatsApp Business account is linked, but no phone number came back. Press Reconnect and finish the number step.
signup.needsRegistering: Your account is linked, but this number needs registering by us before replies can start. Please contact support — your setup is saved, do not run it again.
signup.registerRefused: Your account is linked but Meta would not register the number. Your setup is saved — please contact support rather than running it again.
signup.deliveryRefused: Your account is linked but Meta would not turn on message delivery. Your setup is saved — please contact support rather than running it again.
signup.numberTaken: That WhatsApp number is already connected to another HatchGrab account. A number can only answer for one truck. Contact support and we will move it across.
signup.saveIncomplete: Almost there — we could not finish saving. Your setup is saved, please contact support rather than running it again.
signup.connected: WhatsApp is connected. Auto-replies will start answering messages to this number.

card.justLive: {address} is working. Have a look at it, then tell us it is right below.

waiting.bodySince: You set this up on {date}. New web addresses usually start working within a few minutes, and occasionally take up to 24 hours to reach everyone — there is nothing you need to do while that happens. If someone else was adding the line for you, it is worth checking they did.
waiting.body: New web addresses usually start working within a few minutes, and occasionally take up to 24 hours to reach everyone — there is nothing you need to do while that happens. If someone else was adding the line for you, it is worth checking they did.

turnOff.failed: We could not switch that off just now. Nothing has changed — your address is still working. Try again shortly.

wizard.resumeFailedTitle: We could not load your setup.

address.intro: Your schedule gets its own web address.
address.question: What is your web address?
address.hint: The one people already use to find you.
address.noChange: Your website does not change — you just add a link to the new address.
address.notSetUp: We have not set this up.
address.restricted: Whoever looks after your web address has to let us set up the padlock — the little lock customers see beside it. Until they add us it will not appear, so we have stopped rather than leave you waiting for it. Ask them to add us, then try again.
address.blocked: Your web address currently blocks the padlock completely. Whoever looks after it has to allow it before this can work. Ask them to change that, then try again.
address.elsewhere: Something already answers on that address. Send the message on the next screen to whoever looks after it — they will know what to do.
address.provider: Your web address is looked after by {provider}. We will show you where to go.
address.provisionFailed: We could not set that address up.
address.couldNotBeSetUp: That address could not be set up.

apex.empty: Type the address you would like to use.
apex.not_a_domain: That does not look like a web address.
apex.unparseable: We could not read that as a web address. Check the spelling and try again.
apex.apex: {host} is your whole website address. If you point that at us, your website is replaced by this page. Put a word in front of it instead — for example events.{host}.
apex.too_deep: That address has too many parts. Something like events.{domain} works best.

record.addSomewhere: Add this where your web address is looked after, and save.
record.hintWord: Just this word, not the whole address.
record.timing: It usually starts working within an hour, though it can take longer. You do not need to keep this page open.
record.someoneElse: Someone else looks after your web address?

cloudflare.open: Open your web address, then “DNS” and “Records”.
cloudflare.add: Select “Add record”, then pick “CNAME” as the “Type”.
cloudflare.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
cloudflare.value: Put the second value below in “Target”.
cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only” — the cloud beside it must be grey, not orange.
cloudflare.caveat: If the cloud stays orange the padlock will never appear, and nothing will say why.

godaddy.open: Open your “Domain Portfolio” and choose your web address.
godaddy.add: Select “Add New Record”, then pick “CNAME” from the “Type” menu.
godaddy.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
godaddy.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
godaddy.save: Leave “TTL” as it is and select “Save”.
godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one at once, the button says “Save All Records”.

123reg.signIn: Sign in to your “123 Reg Control Panel”.
123reg.manage: Beside “Domains”, select “Manage All”, then choose your web address.
123reg.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value”, and add a full stop to the end of it.
123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a full stop at the end of the second value or it will not work.

wix.open: Open “Domains”, then click the “Domain Actions” icon beside your web address.
wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section, click “+ Add Record”, then click “Got it”.
wix.name: Put the first value below in “Host Name”.
wix.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
wix.save: Click “Save”, then click “Save Changes” in the pop-up.
wix.caveat: If your web address only points at Wix rather than being held there, Wix cannot make this change — whoever holds it has to.

instructionsEmail.subject: One record to add for {truckName}’s schedule page
instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting {truckName}’s live schedule on {address}, and it needs one record adding to our domain at {provider}.
instructionsEmail.introHolder: We are putting {truckName}’s live schedule on {address}, and it needs one record adding to our domain with whoever holds our domain.
instructionsEmail.wholeChange: That is the whole change — nothing else on the website is affected, and the rest of our domain keeps working exactly as it does now. It usually starts working within an hour.
instructionsEmail.pointsAt: The page it points at shows where we are trading next and keeps itself up to date.
instructionsEmail.replyTo: Reply to {email} if you have any questions.

liveEmail.subject: {address} is working
liveEmail.body: Your schedule is now showing at your own address. Have a look at it and check it is right: open {address}, make sure the events are yours and the dates look correct.
liveEmail.confirm: When you have, open your settings on HatchGrab and tell us it is right. Nothing depends on that — it just means we know a person has seen it.
